Architecture

System Architecture

Platform Architecture Overview

The BCM Platform employs a modern microservices architecture designed for scalability, resilience, and performance. Our architecture ensures that each component can scale independently while maintaining system coherence through event-driven communication.

Service Communication Patterns

Synchronous Communication

  • REST APIs for client-server interactions
  • GraphQL for flexible data queries
  • gRPC for high-performance inter-service calls

Asynchronous Communication

  • Event-driven architecture using RabbitMQ
  • Pub/Sub patterns for system-wide notifications
  • CQRS for command and query separation

Data Flow Architecture

sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant API Gateway
    participant Service
    participant Cache
    participant Database
    participant Event Bus

    User->>API Gateway: Request
    API Gateway->>Service: Authorized Request
    Service->>Cache: Check Cache

    alt Cache Hit
        Cache-->>Service: Cached Data
    else Cache Miss
        Service->>Database: Query Data
        Database-->>Service: Result Set
        Service->>Cache: Update Cache
    end

    Service-->>API Gateway: Response
    API Gateway-->>User: JSON Response

    Service->>Event Bus: Publish Event
    Event Bus->>Other Services: Notify Subscribers

Zero Trust Architecture

  • Identity Verification: Multi-factor authentication for all users
  • Device Trust: Device compliance checking and management
  • Network Segmentation: Microsegmentation and lateral movement prevention
  • Least Privilege: Role-based access with minimal required permissions
  • Continuous Verification: Real-time security posture assessment

  • Multi-Region Deployment: Active-active configuration across regions

Performance Architecture

Caching Strategy

  • Multi-Level Caching: Browser, CDN, API Gateway, Application, Database
  • Cache Invalidation: Event-driven cache invalidation for consistency
  • Distributed Caching: Redis cluster for session and data caching
  • Query Optimization: Materialized views and query result caching

Scalability Patterns

  • Horizontal Scaling: Stateless services with shared-nothing architecture
  • Database Sharding: Partition data by tenant and time
  • Read Replicas: Separate read and write workloads
  • Async Processing: Queue-based processing for heavy operations

Technology Standards

Development Standards

  • Languages: Python 3.11+, TypeScript 5+, Go 1.21+
  • Frameworks: FastAPI, Next.js 15, React 19
  • Testing: 80% code coverage requirement
  • Documentation: OpenAPI 3.0 specifications

Operational Standards

  • Containers: Docker with multi-stage builds
  • Orchestration: Kubernetes 1.28+
  • CI/CD: GitOps with ArgoCD
  • Monitoring: OpenTelemetry standards

Security Standards

  • Encryption: TLS 1.3 minimum
  • Authentication: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect
  • Secrets: HashiCorp Vault integration
  • Compliance: SOC 2, ISO 27001 aligned
